caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic or porcelain figurine of a dog resembling a Dalmatian, positioned in a seated posture on an oval base. The dog is white with numerous small black spots distributed across its body, face, and legs. It has a yellow collar around its neck, attached to a yellow chain that rests loosely over its shoulder. The dog's facial features, including two almond-shaped eyes, a nose, and a mouth with visible whisker marks, are illustrated in black, with red coloration around the mouth. The figurine sits atop a solid, oval base that is predominantly deep blue or purple, with a thin gold or yellow stripe near the bottom edge. The background is plain and off-white, with the name "ZOLTON LUPUS" inscribed in small, uppercase letters to the right of the base of the figurine.
title: Dog (Mantel Ornament)
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
